summary: FERC's Office of Energy Market Regulation issues a deficiency letter on October 9, 2026 asking MISO for more information on its ZGIA filing, including resource adequacy treatment, the Transient Tolerance Window and contingency studies, with a 45-day response period.

points.point: Staff finds MISO's August 18 ZGIA submittal deficient and requests more information.
points.quote: Please be advised that your submittal is deficient and that additional information is necessary to process the filing.

points.point: Staff asks why a Seasonal Accredited Capacity set by participation type is just and reasonable for a resource that cannot inject beyond its point of interconnection.
points.quote: Please explain why it is just and reasonable to assign a SAC for a ZG Resource, which cannot inject beyond its point of interconnection, using the currently effective method based on participation type

points.point: Staff questions treating a 100 MW ZG Interconnection Service resource as equally deliverable as a 100 MW Network Resource Interconnection Service resource.
points.quote: please explain why it is just and reasonable to consider these two resources as equally deliverable to load.

points.point: Staff asks how the Transient Tolerance Window will be set per resource, including when it would be shorter than 20 seconds.
points.quote: Please explain how MISO and the applicable transmission owner will establish the Transient Tolerance Window applicable to each ZG Resource, including the circumstances in which it would require a window shorter than 20 seconds.

points.point: Staff asks how the ZG Impact Assessment will evaluate injections during the window and the contingencies it will study.
points.quote: Please explain how MISO will evaluate, in the ZG Impact Assessment, the amount, in MW, of injections during the Transient Tolerance Window

points.point: MISO has 45 days to respond, and the response amends the filing and sets a new filing date.
points.quote: A response to this letter must be filed with the Secretary of the Commission within 45 days of the date of this letter

throughLine.text: Staff questions the resource adequacy and reliability design of MISO's ZGIA, the first piece of MISO's E-8 response on co-located load, in the separate ER26-3552 proceeding.

figures.label: Response period to the deficiency letter
figures.quote: within 45 days of the date of this letter
